description: AI acceptance rate metrics computed from the corrections table across proposal sources (local_extractor, gemini, manual). Measures what proportion of proposals the doctor confirmed without changes.
measurement_note: No acceptance measurement exists. Acceptance rate requires a doctor to confirm or edit AI proposals and depends on real usage; the synthetic seed data writes prescriptions directly and creates no corrections rows, so running scripts/acceptance_rate.py against the demo database returns 0/0 for every source. The targets below are expectations, not results, and must not be quoted as observed acceptance rates.

metrics.acceptance_rate_definition: accepted / total, where accepted = total - changed (was_changed == 0)
metrics.note: A change is recorded whenever the doctor modifies either the dosha imbalance or any prescribed herb (name or quantity) before confirming.

local_extractor.description: Deterministic rule-based extractor (T1 tagger + T2 assembly + T3 verifier)

gemini.description: Google Gemini cloud model (fallback or external draft)

manual.description: Doctor entered directly via /prescribe/manual-preview without AI proposal
manual.note: Manual previews bypass AI corrections logging to avoid misrepresenting manual entries as unchanged AI proposals.
